name: dsh-desktop
description: DeepSeek Harness 桌面 GUI：Electron + WSL2/Windows 本机内嵌 dsh 运行时
author: DSH Desktop

scripts.runtime:build: npm run runtime:build:linux && npm run runtime:build:win32
scripts.runtime:rebuild: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/build-embedded-runtime.ps1 -Force && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/build-embedded-runtime-win32.ps1 -Force
scripts.runtime:verify: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/build-embedded-runtime.ps1 -VerifyOnly && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/build-embedded-runtime-win32.ps1 -VerifyOnly
scripts.start: npm run runtime:build && npm run build && electron .
scripts.start:dev: npm run runtime:build && npm run build && electron . --dev
scripts.smoke: npm run runtime:build && npm run build && node scripts/smoke.js
scripts.dist: npm run runtime:build && npm run build && electron-builder --win
scripts.dist:portable: npm run runtime:build && npm run build && electron-builder --win portable
